n8eb200f7c04.s: Part IX of the Constitution, inserted by the 73rd Amendment, comprises which Articles?
n8eb200f7c04.x: The 73rd Amendment inserted Part IX, Articles 243 to 243O, along with the Eleventh Schedule of 29 subjects.

n3f7a336f039.s: Which of the following is left to the discretion of the States under the 73rd Amendment?
o: A minimum age of 21 years for membership
Devolution of the 29 Eleventh Schedule subjects to Panchayats
Fresh elections within six months of dissolution
n3f7a336f039.x: Actual devolution of the 29 Eleventh Schedule subjects is voluntary; the minimum age, five-year term and polls within six months are compulsory.

n0d9e1023bea.s: Which State has no Scheduled Caste population, so SC reservation in its Panchayats is inapplicable?
n0d9e1023bea.x: Arunachal Pradesh has no SC population, so SC reservation does not apply there, though the rest of Part IX does.

n5fe16e94fd3.s: The 74th Constitutional Amendment, concerning urban local bodies, came into force on:
n5fe16e94fd3.x: The 74th Amendment (urban bodies) commenced on 1 June 1993; 24 April 1993 is the commencement date of the 73rd (rural Panchayats).

nd5ac34326b3.s: Article 243A of the Constitution deals with:
nd5ac34326b3.x: Article 243A is the Gram Sabha; 243B is the constitution of Panchayats, 243C their composition and 243D reservation.

n7943254252e.s: A Panchayat constituted after the early dissolution of a Panchayat continues for:
o: Only the remainder of the dissolved Panchayat's term
Until the next State Assembly election
n7943254252e.x: A Panchayat formed after early dissolution serves only the remainder of the period the dissolved Panchayat would have continued.

n8790405a810.s: At least one-third of the offices of chairpersons in Panchayats are reserved for women under:
n8790405a810.x: Article 243D(4) reserves at least one-third of the offices of chairpersons in Panchayats for women.

nffe68f7eaa8.s: Under PESA, 1996, the Gram Sabha in Fifth Schedule areas controls:
o: Appointment of the State Election Commissioner
nffe68f7eaa8.x: Under PESA the Gram Sabha is not merely advisory; it controls village markets and liquor.

n1f2f53e9d71.s: Which of the following States is exempted from Part IX of the Constitution under Article 243M?
n1f2f53e9d71.x: Article 243M exempts Nagaland, Meghalaya and Mizoram, besides Scheduled and tribal areas and the Manipur hill areas with District Councils.

n1e57c9feb37.s: Which area of West Bengal is excluded from Part IX by Article 243M?
o: The municipal corporation area of Kolkata
The hill council area of Darjeeling district
All coastal districts of West Bengal
The entire State of West Bengal
n1e57c9feb37.x: Article 243M excludes the hill council area of Darjeeling district from the application of Part IX.

n543551da46c.s: The 13 Zilla Parishads of Andhra Pradesh are being reorganised into ____ Zilla Parishads.
n543551da46c.x: The reorganisation increases the number of Zilla Parishads in Andhra Pradesh from 13 to 28.

n04adce0240a.s: Under the triple test of Vikas Kishanrao Gawali v. State of Maharashtra (2021), aggregate SC, ST and OBC reservation must stay within:
n04adce0240a.x: The triple test requires a dedicated commission, local-body-wise reservation on its findings and aggregate SC, ST and OBC reservation within 50 per cent. (Built as a one-liner: the facts carry no dates for a sequence.)

nindian-polity-1-59.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Madras – First Municipal Corporation in India (1688)
Bihar – First State to implement the 73rd Amendment in its true spirit
Madhya Pradesh – Panchayati Raj inaugurated by Jawaharlal Nehru
Nagaur – First Municipal Corporation in India
nindian-polity-1-59.x: Madras had India's first Municipal Corporation in 1688. Nehru inaugurated Panchayati Raj at Nagaur, and Madhya Pradesh was the first to implement the 73rd Amendment in its true spirit.

nee57df82ec1.s: Which Article extends the State Finance Commission's review of finances to Municipalities?
nee57df82ec1.x: Article 243I provides the State Finance Commission for Panchayats; Article 243Y applies the corresponding review to Municipalities.

nfb6a4a4b316.s: The share of Central taxes devolved on the Union Finance Commission's recommendation is paid to:
nfb6a4a4b316.x: Central tax devolution goes to the States; Panchayats get Central assistance through Finance Commission grants routed through the State.

n8d1f1570314.s: Which of the following represents the three Panchayati Raj tiers of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Gram Sabha, Municipal Council and Zilla Parishad
Village Council, Taluk Board and District Council
Gram Panchayat, Nagar Panchayat and Zilla Parishad
Gram Panchayat, Mandal Parishad and Zilla Parishad
n8d1f1570314.x: Andhra Pradesh has Gram Panchayats, Mandal Parishads (Mandal Praja Parishads) and Zilla Parishads.

nindian-polity-37-46.s: Under Article 243B, the three-tier Panchayati Raj structure is:
o: A constitutional requirement, with the middle tier optional for States of 20 lakh or less
nindian-polity-37-46.x: The three-tier structure is compulsory under Article 243B, though States with a population of 20 lakh or less may skip the middle tier.

n5d7aa9483e7.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the 73rd Constitutional Amendment is correctly matched?
o: Status given to PRIs – Non-justiciable part of the Constitution
n5d7aa9483e7.x: The 73rd Amendment brought PRIs into the justiciable part and shifted rural democracy from merely representative to participatory; it added Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule.

nf479dfe709b.s: The Mandal Praja Parishad is a Panchayati Raj body of which State?
nf479dfe709b.x: Mandal Praja Parishad is associated with Andhra Pradesh; Assam has Zila Parishads at the sub-divisional level and Mizoram has no village panchayats.

nb409e06fc8c.s: The Constitution (Seventy-Fourth Amendment) Act, 1992 received Presidential assent in:
nb409e06fc8c.x: The 74th Amendment was passed by both Houses in December 1992, received assent in April 1993 and came into force on 1 June 1993.

n96e91061011.s: Audit of municipal accounts is provided under which Article?
n96e91061011.x: Audit of municipal accounts is under Article 243Z; 243X concerns taxes and funds, 243U duration and 243R composition.

n6ae61d0f62e.s: Operationalising District Planning Committees continues to be a mandate of the Ministry of:
n6ae61d0f62e.x: DPCs remain weak in most States, and operationalising them is listed among the mandates of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj.

n11bee1188c2.s: Which urban local body falls outside the three types of municipalities recognised under Article 243Q?
n11bee1188c2.x: Article 243Q recognises Nagar Panchayats, Municipal Councils and Municipal Corporations; Cantonment Boards lie outside this classification.

nindian-polity-37-45.s: Under the 74th Amendment, a smaller urban area has a:
nindian-polity-37-45.x: Municipal Councils serve smaller urban areas and Municipal Corporations larger ones; Nagar Panchayats are for transitional areas.

n0cf547e38e1.s: The composition and territorial area of a Wards Committee are determined by the:
n0cf547e38e1.x: Under Article 243S, State law determines the composition and territorial area of Wards Committees, which may cover one or more wards.

nindian-polity-37-7.s: Part IX-A of the Constitution contains which Articles?
nindian-polity-37-7.x: The 74th Amendment added Part IX-A (Articles 243P to 243ZG); Part IX of the 73rd covers Articles 243 to 243O.

nindian-polity-37-28.s: Which Articles bar a person under 21 years from membership of a Panchayat and a Municipality respectively?
nindian-polity-37-28.x: Articles 243F (Panchayats) and 243V (Municipalities) disqualify anyone under 21, making 21 the minimum qualifying age.

nindian-polity-37-31.s: The fixed term of a Panchayat or Municipality under the 73rd and 74th Amendments is:
nindian-polity-37-31.x: Local bodies have a five-year term; after early dissolution elections are held within six months unless less than six months remain.

naea4a498ceb.s: Which of the following is among the eight types of urban local bodies listed for India?
naea4a498ceb.x: The eight types are Municipal Corporation, Municipality, Notified Area Committee, Town Area Committee, Cantonment Board, Township, Port Trust and Special Purpose Agency.

n43991a4f947.s: Elected representation in a Metropolitan Planning Committee follows the ratio of urban and rural:
n43991a4f947.x: Elected MPC representation follows the urban-rural population ratio, not area.

nc2315d26eb5.s: The Constitution requires at least what share of the members of a District Planning Committee to be elected?
nc2315d26eb5.x: At least four-fifths of DPC members must be elected; the rest are decided by State law, so the DPC is not wholly elected.

n13a07c9934c.s: The draft development plan of a DPC or MPC is forwarded to the State Government by its:
n13a07c9934c.x: The chairperson of the DPC or MPC forwards the draft plan to the State Government; State law, not Parliament, settles how the chairperson is chosen.

nf9615a9d422.s: Which of the following pairs relating to District Planning Committees is correctly matched?
o: Kerala DPC – District Collector as member-secretary
Kerala DPC – Chaired by the District Collector
Andhra Pradesh DPC – Chaired by the District Panchayat President
Kerala DPC – Plans prepared apart from the People's Plan Campaign
nf9615a9d422.x: In Kerala the District Panchayat President chairs the DPC and the Collector is only member-secretary; the DPC integrates People's Plan Campaign plans. A Collector-chaired DPC is the AP pattern.

nedcdff2fe68.s: As per the AP Socio-Economic Survey 2025-26, the number of Municipal Corporations among the State's 123 urban local bodies is:
nedcdff2fe68.x: The Survey 2025-26 lists 17 Municipal Corporations, 76 Municipalities and 30 Nagar Panchayats among AP's 123 ULBs.

nd553ada3710.s: In which of the following States has no Scheduled Tribe been notified?
nd553ada3710.x: No Scheduled Tribe has been notified in Delhi, Punjab, Haryana, Puducherry or Chandigarh; Gujarat, Himachal Pradesh and Rajasthan are PESA States with Scheduled Areas.

n275dafc1e9e.s: Which of the following is among the ten Fifth Schedule States covered by PESA?
n275dafc1e9e.x: The ten PESA States are AP, Telangana, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Himachal Pradesh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Odisha and Rajasthan.

nindian-polity-49-18.s: The report on the administration of Scheduled Areas is submitted by the Governor to the:
nindian-polity-49-18.x: The President declares Scheduled Areas and the Governor reports to the President; the Chief Minister does not report to the Home Ministry.

nindian-polity-49-24.s: Which of the following is a Sixth Schedule State?
nindian-polity-49-24.x: Assam is covered by the Sixth Schedule; Andhra Pradesh is a Fifth Schedule State, and Nagaland is not covered by the Sixth Schedule.

nindian-polity-43-11.s: Article 243M lets Parliament extend Part IX to the Scheduled Areas with modifications. Parliament did so through the:
nindian-polity-43-11.x: Article 243M keeps Part IX out of the Scheduled Areas unless Parliament extends it, which PESA, 1996 did with modifications.

nefddfb1e352.s: An Autonomous District Council under the Sixth Schedule may make laws on:
nefddfb1e352.x: District Councils may legislate on inheritance, village administration and social customs among local tribal matters; citizenship is outside their field.

n391fa9347f4.s: Grants-in-aid from the Consolidated Fund of India for Sixth Schedule areas are provided under Article:
n391fa9347f4.x: Article 275 grants-in-aid from the Consolidated Fund of India are the constitutional financial assistance for Sixth Schedule areas.

nbef8d67cecb.s: Which of the following is an area of special focus of the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes?
o: Regulation of inter-State trade in agricultural commodities
nbef8d67cecb.x: The NCST focuses on minor forest produce, mineral and water rights, and rehabilitation of displaced tribals.

nindian-society-42-7.s: The Virginius Xaxa Committee on tribal communities was constituted by the:
nindian-society-42-7.x: The PMO set up the Xaxa Committee, which recommended stopping tribal land alienation and strictly enforcing the Forest Rights Act, 2006.

n390f9ea6b30.s: A Ministry of Panchayati Raj assessment found that over what share of elected representatives in PESA panchayats were unable to explain what a Gram Sabha is?
n390f9ea6b30.x: More than 40 per cent of elected representatives in PESA panchayats could not explain what a Gram Sabha is.

n5335404969e.s: Under PESA, the Gram Sabha's power over minor forest produce is that of:
n5335404969e.x: PESA confers ownership of minor forest produce; land acquisition needs consultation and minor-mineral leases a recommendation.

nindian-society-50-6.s: The Panchayats (Extension to the Scheduled Areas) Act came into force on:
nindian-society-50-6.x: PESA came into force on 24 December 1996; it extends Part IX to Schedule V areas and empowers traditional Gram Sabhas.

n1ab49ac2dd3.s: The creation of autonomous regions with legislative powers is associated with the:
n1ab49ac2dd3.x: Autonomous regions belong to the Sixth Schedule; PESA extends Panchayati Raj to Fifth Schedule areas and protects tribal self-governance.

new.s: The State Election Commissioner under Article 243K is appointed by the:
new.x: The State Election Commissioner is appointed by the Governor and conducts all Panchayat elections.

new.s: The State Election Commissioner can be removed only in the manner and on the grounds of removing a:
o: Member of the State Finance Commission
new.x: Article 243K protects the State Election Commissioner: removal is only like a High Court judge, and service conditions cannot be varied to his disadvantage.

new.s: The Andhra Pradesh State Election Commission was formed on:
new.x: The AP SEC was formed on 17 June 1994 under the AP Panchayat Raj Act, 1994, which itself dates from 21 April 1994.

new.s: A 2020 ordinance, struck down by the High Court, sought to cut the AP State Election Commissioner's term from five years to:
new.x: The 2020 ordinance reducing the term from five to three years was struck down by the High Court.

new.s: The AP State Election Commissioner must hold or have held a post not below the rank of:
new.x: The AP law requires the Commissioner to hold or have held a post not below Principal Secretary.

new.s: Under Part IX, the chairpersons of intermediate and district Panchayats are elected:
o: Indirectly, by and from among the elected members
new.x: Only members are directly elected; intermediate and district chairpersons are chosen indirectly by and from among elected members.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about elections under Part IX:
1. Members at all three levels are directly elected from territorial constituencies.
2. The manner of electing the village chairperson is left to State law.
3. District Panchayat chairpersons are directly elected by voters.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: district and intermediate chairpersons are elected indirectly by elected members.

new.s: Seats reserved under Article 243D are allotted to different constituencies in a Panchayat by:
new.x: Reserved seats under Article 243D go by rotation among constituencies.

new.s: Reservation for backward classes in Panchayats is enabled by:
new.x: Article 243D(6) makes BC reservation optional for States; 243D(4) is the women's chairperson quota.

new.s: The 5th State Finance Commission of Andhra Pradesh was constituted on:
new.x: The 5th SFC was constituted on 20 March 2023 after a PIL over delay and reported on 31 December 2024.

new.s: The report of the 5th Andhra Pradesh State Finance Commission covers the period:
new.x: The 5th SFC, chaired by Prof. S. Rathna Kumari, submitted its report for 2025–30 on 31 December 2024.

new.s: Which State ranked first in the Devolution Index 'Status of Devolution to Panchayats in States 2024'?
new.x: Karnataka was first (72.23), followed by Kerala (70.59) and Tamil Nadu (68.38).

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's score in the Devolution Index 2024 of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj and IIPA was:
new.x: AP scored 54.43, in the medium band with Himachal Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha.

new.s: According to Ministry of Panchayati Raj data (April 2026), the total number of elected PRI representatives is about:
new.x: Of 24.41 lakh elected PRI representatives, 12.14 lakh (49.75 per cent) are women.

new.s: Gram Panchayat Development Plans are prepared through Gram Sabhas under the:
o: People's Plan Campaign 'Sabki Yojana Sabka Vikas'
new.x: The People's Plan Campaign, running since 2 October 2018, prepares GPDPs through Gram Sabhas.

new.s: Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans are linked to:
new.x: Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans are linked to PM Gati Shakti.

new.s: The Smart Cities Mission, launched in 2015 for 100 cities, formally ended on:
new.x: The Smart Cities Mission formally ended on 31 March 2025; 97 per cent of its projects were done by 31 March 2026.

new.s: Which Andhra Pradesh institution won the first prize in the Capacity Building Institution Award of the National Panchayat Awards (2026)?
new.x: Chittoor DPRC won the 1st Capacity Building Institution Award (Rs 1 crore); Kanipakam won 2nd in the Atmanirbhar Special Award.

new.s: Which Article exempts certain areas from Part IXA (Municipalities)?
new.x: 243ZC is the Part IXA exemption; 243M exempts areas from Part IX, and 244A concerns an autonomous State in Assam.

new.s: The last Article of Part IX, Article 243O, provides for:
o: Bar on interference by courts in electoral matters
new.x: Article 243O bars courts in electoral matters; 243N continues existing laws for up to one year, 243K is the SEC and 243L the UTs.

new.s: Audit of the accounts of Panchayats is provided under:
new.x: Article 243J deals with audit; 243H with taxes and funds, 243I with the SFC and 243K with the SEC.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Eleventh Schedule:
1. It includes fisheries.
2. It includes rural electrification.
3. It includes public order.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Fisheries and rural electrification are Eleventh Schedule items; public order is not.

new.s: Janpad Panchayat is the name of the intermediate Panchayati Raj tier in:
new.x: Janpad Panchayat is Madhya Pradesh's intermediate tier; UP has Kshetra Panchayat, Assam Anchalik Panchayat and Karnataka Taluk Panchayat.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of Panchayati Raj body and State is correctly matched?
new.x: Kshetra Panchayat is in UP; Janpad Panchayat is MP, Anchalik Panchayat Assam, and Taluk Panchayat Karnataka and Gujarat.

new.s: National Panchayati Raj Day, marking the commencement of the 73rd Amendment, is observed on:
new.x: The 73rd Amendment came into force on 24 April 1993, observed as National Panchayati Raj Day.

new.s: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj was created on:
new.x: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj was created on 27 May 2004 and handles Part IX, PESA and DPCs.

new.s: Which State pioneered the three-tier Panchayati Raj system with its 1973 Act and 1978 elections?
new.x: West Bengal pioneered the three-tier system (1973 Act, 1978 polls).

new.s: Under the 73rd Amendment, reservation of seats for backward classes in Panchayats is:
new.x: SC/ST reservation is mandatory, but BC reservation is left to the States (a common trap).

new.s: The only States fully exempt from Part IX are:
new.x: Article 243M fully exempts Nagaland, Meghalaya and Mizoram; Manipur is exempt only for its hill areas with District Councils.

new.s: Drone mapping of rural inhabited areas under SVAMITVA is carried out by:
new.x: SVAMITVA, launched on 24 April 2020, uses drone mapping by the Survey of India and NICSI for the Record of Rights.

new.s: Which of the following about women's reservation in Panchayats is NOT correct?
o: Bihar gave 50 per cent reservation in 2006
Andhra Pradesh gives 50 per cent reservation
One-third reservation for women is a ceiling
new.x: The one-third reservation is a floor, not a ceiling; many States, including AP, give 50 per cent.

new.s: India's first Municipal Corporation began functioning at Madras in:
new.x: The Madras Corporation began in 1688; Bombay and Calcutta followed in 1726.

new.s: Lord Mayo's resolution of 1870 is associated with:
o: Local self-government as a Transferred subject
new.x: Mayo's 1870 resolution = financial decentralisation; Ripon's 1882 resolution is the 'Magna Carta'.

new.s: Under the Government of India Act, 1919, local self-government became a:
new.x: Under dyarchy (1919), local self-government was a Transferred subject under elected Ministers.

new.s: Who called Indian village communities 'Little Republics'?
new.x: Charles Metcalfe called Indian village communities 'Little Republics'.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of functionary and institution is correctly matched?
new.x: The Pradhan heads the Panchayat Samiti; the Sarpanch heads the Gram Panchayat and the Mayor the Municipal Corporation.

new.s: The Sarpanch is the head of the:
new.x: The Sarpanch heads the Gram Panchayat; the Pradhan heads the Panchayat Samiti.

new.s: VMRDA was formed in 2018 by dissolving which body?
new.x: VMRDA (G.O.Ms. 302, 5 September 2018) replaced VUDA (1978); it covers Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram and Anakapalli.

new.s: APCRDA, set up in December 2014, plans and develops the capital region and:
new.x: APCRDA under the APCRDA Act (11 of 2014) plans and develops the capital region and Amaravati.

new.s: Under the proviso to Article 243Q, no municipality need be constituted in an area where municipal services are provided by:
new.x: Where an industrial establishment provides municipal services, the area may be an industrial township without a municipality.

new.s: The areas for Nagar Panchayats, Municipal Councils and Municipal Corporations are specified by the:
new.x: Under Article 243Q the Governor specifies the areas by public notification on population, density, revenue and similar factors.

new.s: Under Article 243R, the members of a municipality are chosen by:
o: Election by MLAs of the area
new.x: Article 243R requires members to be directly elected from wards; State law may add non-voting experts and legislators.

new.s: The Telangana SEC (February 2026) ruled that in Mayor and Chairperson polls, ex-officio voting is limited to:
o: Lok Sabha members and MLAs of the area
Rajya Sabha members and MLCs registered as voters in the ULB
new.x: Only Rajya Sabha members and MLCs registered as voters in the ULB may vote as ex-officio members.

new.s: Article 243X relating to municipalities deals with:
new.x: Article 243X covers taxes and funds; audit is 243Z, duration 243U and disqualifications 243V.

new.s: The last Article of Part IXA, Article 243ZG, deals with:
o: Bar on interference by courts in electoral matters
new.x: 243ZG bars courts in electoral matters; 243ZF continues existing laws, 243ZE is the MPC and 243ZC exemptions.

new.s: Which of the following is found only in the Eleventh Schedule and not in the Twelfth?
new.x: Technical and vocational education is an Eleventh Schedule item; the other three are Twelfth Schedule items.

new.s: Which of the following is a Twelfth Schedule item absent from the Eleventh Schedule?
new.x: Vital statistics is only in the Twelfth Schedule; non-conventional energy, PDS and libraries are Eleventh Schedule items.

new.s: Part IXB of the Constitution, on Co-operative Societies, was added by the:
new.x: Part IXB came from the 97th Amendment, 2011; the 74th added Part IXA and the 42nd added Part IVA.

new.s: Under Article 243ZF, existing municipal laws inconsistent with Part IXA could continue for up to:
new.x: State laws had to conform to Part IXA within one year (Article 243ZF).

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the District Planning Committee:
1. It was provided by the 74th Amendment.
2. It consolidates the plans of panchayats and municipalities.
3. All its members are elected.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: at least four-fifths, not all, of DPC members are elected.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the District Planning Committee is chaired by the:
new.x: In AP the Collector chairs the DPC; Rajasthan's is chaired by the Zila Pramukh and Kerala's by the District Panchayat President.

new.s: The Area Sabha, made up of all voters of a polling-booth area, was proposed in the:
new.x: The Area Sabha comes from the Model Nagara Raj Bill (2008); the Community Participation Law was a JNNURM reform.

new.s: Laws on the audit of municipal accounts under Article 243Z are made by the:
new.x: Audit laws under Articles 243J and 243Z are made by the State Legislature, not Parliament, the CAG or the Collector.

new.s: The AP Municipal Corporations Act, 1994 applies which parent law?
new.x: The AP Municipal Corporations Act, 1994 applies the Hyderabad Municipal Corporations Act, 1955; municipalities come under the AP Municipalities Act, 1965.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a compulsory provision for municipalities under the 74th Amendment?
o: Wards Committees in municipalities of 3 lakh or more
new.x: The manner of electing the Chairperson or Mayor is left to the State legislature; the other three are compulsory.

new.s: The proviso to Article 164(1) requires a Minister for tribal welfare in which States?
o: Bihar, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha
Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan
Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Odisha and Madhya Pradesh
Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha
new.x: The Article 164(1) proviso names Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha.

new.s: Which Constitutional Amendment replaced Bihar in the Article 164(1) proviso on a tribal welfare minister?
new.x: The 94th Amendment, 2006 replaced Bihar with Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand in the proviso.

new.s: Reservation of seats for Scheduled Tribes in the Lok Sabha is provided under Article:
new.x: Article 330 covers Lok Sabha seats and Article 332 State Assembly seats for STs.

new.s: Article 339 of the Constitution deals with:
o: The National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
Union control over Scheduled Area administration and ST welfare
new.x: Article 339 = Union control; 244A = autonomous State in Assam; 338A = NCST; 342 = ST notification.

new.s: Article 244A of the Constitution provides for:
new.x: Article 244A enables an autonomous State within Assam.

new.s: As per Census 2011 data, the largest tribe in India is the:
new.x: The Bhil are the largest tribe; Madhya Pradesh has the largest tribal population.

new.s: Which of the following applies to Fifth Schedule areas but not to Sixth Schedule areas?
new.x: PESA applies to Fifth Schedule areas only; ADCs, Regional Councils and Article 275(1) grants belong to the Sixth Schedule.

new.s: The key body of the Fifth Schedule is the Tribes Advisory Council; that of the Sixth Schedule is the:
new.x: Fifth Schedule: advisory TAC; Sixth Schedule: Autonomous District and Regional Councils.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Fifth and Sixth Schedules:
1. Scheduled Areas under the Fifth Schedule are declared by the President.
2. The Tribes Advisory Council has legislative powers.
3. Both Schedules aim to protect the interests, land and culture of Scheduled Tribes.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is wrong: the TAC is advisory, with no legislative or judicial power.

new.s: The number of Autonomous District Councils under the Sixth Schedule is:
new.x: There are 10 ADCs: Assam 3, Meghalaya 3, Tripura 1 and Mizoram 3.

new.s: In which Sixth Schedule State does the Governor direct how Acts apply to the tribal areas?
new.x: Laws apply as directed by the Governor in Assam and by the President in Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram.

new.s: Which of the following about the Sixth Schedule is NOT correct?
o: Four ADC members are nominated by the Governor
It applies wherever STs exceed 40 per cent of the population
An Autonomous District Council has 30 members
Tripura has one Autonomous District Council
new.x: The '40 per cent' claim is false (APPSC G2 2025 trap); the Sixth Schedule covers only Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram.

new.s: Regulations made by the Governor under Paragraph 5 of the Fifth Schedule take effect only after:
new.x: Paragraph 5 regulations are made after consulting the TAC and need the President's assent.

new.s: About what share of the members of a Tribes Advisory Council are ST members of the State Legislative Assembly?
new.x: A TAC has not more than 20 members, about three-fourths of them ST MLAs.

new.s: In the Niyamgiri case (2013), the Gram Sabhas rejected the bauxite project of:
new.x: In Niyamgiri (2013) the Gram Sabhas decided and rejected Vedanta's bauxite project.

new.s: As of April 2026, which PESA State had framed only draft PESA rules?
new.x: Odisha had only draft rules (April 2026); AP issued PESA Rules in 2011, while Kerala and Tamil Nadu are not PESA States.

new.s: The AP Scheduled Area Land Transfer Regulation 1 of 1959 was amended by Regulation:
new.x: Regulation 1 of 1959 was amended by Regulation 1 of 1970, banning transfers between tribals and non-tribals and among non-tribals.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh has how many ITDAs, covering 76 mandals?
new.x: AP has 7 ITDAs over 76 mandals: Paderu, Rampachodavaram, Chintoor, Seethampeta, Parvathipuram, KR Puram and Srisailam.

new.s: The number of PESA Gram Sabhas in Andhra Pradesh is about:
new.x: AP has 2,038 PESA Gram Sabhas under PESA 1996, the AP Act 1998 and the AP PESA Rules 2011.

new.s: The KR Puram ITDA of Andhra Pradesh is located in which district?
new.x: KR Puram ITDA is in Eluru; Paderu, Rampachodavaram and Chintoor are in ASR, and Seethampeta and Parvathipuram in Manyam.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh has about how many Scheduled Tribe communities?
new.x: AP has about 12.9 lakh STs belonging to 34 communities.

new.s: Under PESA, the chairpersons of Panchayats at all levels in Scheduled Areas must belong to the:
new.x: PESA reserves at least 50 per cent of seats for STs and all chairperson posts for STs.

new.s: If no ST member is elected to preside, a PESA Gram Sabha meeting is presided over by the:
new.x: The Gram Sabha elects an ST member to preside for one year; otherwise the oldest ST woman present presides, not the Sarpanch.

new.s: The Virginius Xaxa Committee submitted its report in:
new.x: The Xaxa Committee was set up in 2013 by the PMO and reported in May 2014.

new.s: The Dilip Singh Bhuria Committee, the basis of PESA, was set up in:
new.x: The Bhuria Committee (1995) recommended traditional Gram Sabhas in Schedule V areas; Dhebar was 1960 and Lokur 1965.
